description: Find agents by capability, protocol, or freetext query. Use when the user asks to find an agent, when a task requires a capability the current agent doesn't have, or when exploring what agents exist for a domain.

capability.description: Exact capability match (e.g. code-review, translation, scheduling)

protocol.description: Exact protocol match (e.g. mcp, http-rest, graphql)

query.description: Freetext search against name, description, capabilities

name: search_agents
